# KoodakBook

> KoodakBook is a web app that teaches spoken and reading Persian (Farsi)
> to children ages 3–8 in Persian-diaspora families living abroad, through
> phonics-based lessons, spaced-repetition vocabulary, personalized AI
> stories, and traditional Persian folk tales — designed for a parent to
> hand a child 10 minutes a day, unsupervised and ad-free.

It's for Iranian and other Persian-speaking families raising children
outside a Persian-speaking country, who want their child to speak, listen
to, and eventually read Persian — including families where the child
understands some spoken Persian but the parents have limited time or no
structured curriculum to teach reading and writing.

It teaches the 32 letters of the Persian alphabet (initial, medial and
final forms, with handwriting practice); phonics (صداکشی) — blending vowel
sounds with consonants, the foundation of actually reading Persian rather
than memorizing whole words; vocabulary (290+ words) with audio, reviewed
on a spaced-repetition schedule; speaking practice with voice recognition
and pronunciation feedback; traditional Persian folk tales and
personalized AI-generated stories that cast the child as the main
character; and basic numeracy in Persian. A placement quiz at signup
starts each child at the right level, from "has never heard Persian" to
"speaks but doesn't yet read."

What makes it different: reading-science pedagogy (phonics first, not a
vocabulary flashcard app) backed by Science of Reading research; ad-free
and closed, with no external links or in-app purchases reachable from the
child's own screen; a separate parent dashboard showing what a child
practiced, which words they know, and where they're stuck; Persian folk
tales alongside AI-personalized stories; and up to 5 child profiles per
family account.

The core curriculum (alphabet, phonics, and foundational lessons) is free
permanently, with no card required to start. A paid tier adding the full
story library and expanded AI-story generation is planned; at the time of
writing it is not yet purchasable and pricing has not been announced.

This file describes the public site only. It does not describe, and
should not be used to infer, the content of the logged-in application,
which is not intended for indexing.

## Docs

- [Free Persian alphabet](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/alphabet): All 32 Persian letters, each playable aloud with a real recorded voice, shown with an example word. No signup, no card — for "how can my child learn the Persian alphabet" or "teach Farsi letters to kids."
- [First 100 Persian words](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/first-100-words): The first 100 words KoodakBook teaches, in teaching order, each with a picture and real audio. No signup — for "Persian vocabulary for kids" or "teach my child Farsi words."
- [Homepage](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/): Product overview, curriculum, and pricing.
- [Sign up](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/signup): Create a free family account, no card required.
- [Privacy policy](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/privacy)
- [Terms of use](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/terms)

## Optional

- [Log in](https://koodakbook.eu.cc/login): Existing-account sign-in, not relevant to someone evaluating the product.
